overall: The AG found the Board permissibly entered executive session under Purpose 6 but violated the Open Meeting Law because the chair started, but did not complete, the required detrimental-effect declaration; the violation was found unintentional and no remedy was ordered.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Board entered executive session on August 13 for an impermissible purpose, including that the property owner was invited to attend, defeating Purpose 6.
allegations.key_passage: For all of the above reasons, we are satisfied that the Board permissibly convened in executive session on August 13 to consider the value of real property where the Board held a negotiating position.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Board entered executive session on August 13 without the chair declaring that an open meeting might have a detrimental effect on the Board's negotiating position.
allegations.key_passage: Because the requisite declaration was not completed, the Board violated the Open Meeting Law.
